pages.title: Iron's Spellbooks
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- Put spells in a spell book, cast with mana. Better books hold more.
- **Scrolls**: single-use spells anyone can cast.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Scroll Forge makes scrolls; Inscription Table fills books.
- Portal, Recall and Angel Wings are off.

**Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks** adds spellcasting. You carry a spell book, fill its slots with spells, and cast them using [#](7A3C9A)[mana](entry://glossary/mana)[#](). Spells belong to schools, and gear raises the power of one school or all.

pages.title: Scroll
pages.text: A single-use spell. Anyone can cast one, no book needed. Spells are made or found at several tiers of rarity.

pages.title: Spell Books
pages.text: Books run from Flimsy Journal (copper) up to Ancient Codex (netherite). Better books hold more spell slots.

pages.title: Scroll Forge
pages.text: Where scrolls are made. Built from polished deepslate and crying obsidian.

pages.title: Inscription Table
pages.text: Where spells are written into a spell book.

Magic crafting uses:

- ink in five rarities
- Arcane Essence
- Mithril, Pyrium and Arcane Ingots
- Upgrade Orbs that boost a school

An **Alchemist Cauldron**, Arcane Anvil and Pedestals help. Rings and necklaces are worn in [#](2E5AAC)[Curios slots](entry://exploration/gear)[#]().

The world has wizard towers and a lost Citadel. Mage mobs defend them.

- Pyromancer Tower
- Archevoker's Evoker Fort
- Ice Spider Den
- Ancient Battleground
- Catacombs
- the Citadel (a Citadel Map exists)

Pack-wide bosses: [#](2E5AAC)[Bosses](entry://exploration/bosses)[#]().

pages.title: Not in this world
pages.text:
Three spells would replace vehicles, so they never show up in loot, the Scroll Forge or [#](7A3C9A)[JEI](entry://glossary/jei)[#](): **Portal** (permanent two-way links), **Recall** (home from anywhere) and **Angel Wings** (Elytra flight).\
\
Portal Frames and the Hither-Thither Wand can't be crafted. See [#](2E5AAC)[Getting Around](entry://transport/getting_around)[#]().

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Create hooks in directly. Inks, Blood Vials, Timeless Slurry and several elixirs have Create filling and emptying recipes, so a Spout can fill them from fluid and a Drain can empty them.\
\
See [#](2E5AAC)[Fluids](entry://create_basics/fluids)[#]().
